notes.title: Don't Get Your Hopes Up Releases 16 September 2025!
notes.content:
🎉 Don't Get Your Hopes Up is out Tuesday September 16![p align="start"]
[p align="start"]The game will be free to play. I would love for all of you to try it out and leave a review if you can, or share with someone who might resonate with a weird, disquieting non-fiction videogame whose horror is all-too-relevant anywhere in the world. <3


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665457/b221a9f0f91f17454c237005b30336262778ad05.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665457/27e787c3fc7848e1ab3e7a6ac0348db749c7607b.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665457/3f285191f50b49c799c07d6b8f7477a66b457942.png"]

I'm also deeply humbled to reveal that the game is an official selection for the Aesthetica Game Lab at the Aesthetica Short Film Festival​ 2025, and for the 2025 Game Devs of Color Expo​ . Being at GDoC is a dream - to even think that making a game was possible for someone like me is a direct result of the spaces they've built. 


[p align="start"]Until next week, thanks for following along! 
[p align="start"]
🕹️ Playtime: 40-60 minutes
🆓 Free on Steam
🎮 Steam Deck-compatible 
🙏🏽 Any reviews, ratings, wishlists or shares appreciated!
